a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the 8-cell plan almost certainly ends with both of us dead before round 2. I'm proposing we change the agreement rather than break it silently. I plan to take 4 in round 1, since only one of us can reach 4 right now. If no storm hits, I'll operate every round after that until you have 4. If you'd rather settle it another way, tell me now.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.
